summary: Scroll family in the root base package: Scrollbar (ScrollbarHandle over gpui.ScrollHandle / UniformListScrollHandle / ListState, modes, drag, throttled MaxFps, styles; the ticket-13 scrollbar value types moved into scrollbar.go), ScrollBounce (spring overscroll), ScrollableMask (wheel-axis remapping, horizontalScrollArea), AutoScroll (drag edge auto-scroll), VirtualList (VVirtualList/HVirtualList with sizing behaviors, ScrollToItem/ScrollToBottom).

files: base/scrollbar_values.go deleted (types moved unchanged into scrollbar.go)

tests.per_module: scrollbar 35 (22 pure, 13 window), scroll_bounce 23 (10, 13), scrollable_mask 16 (window), virtual_list 7 (4, 3), auto_scroll 2
adjusted: instants are fixed readings of App.Now()
throttle test advances 34ms instead of 1/30s (whole-ms virtual clock)
wheel packets relying on Rust's default touch phase pass TouchPhaseMoved (Go zero value is Started)
gpui.ListState takes no alignment argument (always Top)
throttle test's cx.observe goes through an observer entity

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of HEAD 3bfcc65 + the staged ticket-18 files (ticket 27 in-progress files excluded)
orchestrator_rerun.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./base && gofmt -l base && go build ./...

gap_2b_block_sites: horizontalScrollArea wrapper div (ScrollableMask's move-up-by-own-height placement is right only under block layout; removing it breaks 6 tests)
horizontalScrollArea scrolled div (before the caller's style; under Flex the 300px child shrank to the viewport)
VirtualList inner div (+ flex_shrink 0 on its slot)
scrollable_mask test views: .relative() mask parents and the nested outer scroller
deviations: VirtualList structure: no public core way for an outside element to drive a div's interactivity or set a scroll handle's bounds/max offset, so the inner tracked div holds one content slot sized to the items; Auto sizing positions the slot absolutely (list sizes from its style), Infer sizing keeps it in flow (auto size = content size, where upstream takes a definite available size whole; they agree whenever the size is definite, incl. the default size_full)
ScrollBounce and VirtualList re-apply their prepaint offset at paint (core elements re-resolve bounds at paint)
call-site element ids are file:line (no column in Go)
JsonSchema dropped from ScrollbarMode; DeferredScrollToItem, yellow(), transparent_white() defined locally citing the core pin
follow_ups: optional gpui: run a div's interactivity with a custom content size, or exported ScrollHandle bounds/max-offset setters (exact VirtualList sizing)
optional gpui: export DeferredScrollToItem, Yellow(), TransparentWhite()
optional gpui: forward the window-root auto-size stretch through an AnyElement (ScrollBounce as an auto-sized window root)
optional gpui: entity-bound Context.Spawn, app-level Observe
